layers.name: Core Application
layers.description: Main Rust crates implementing OxiGuitar's music data model, display engine, editor, playback, and plugin API.

layers.name: Plugin Ecosystem
layers.description: External audio backend and file format plugins for SoundFont synthesis, ALSA, CoreAudio, WASAPI, PipeWire, and Guitar Pro variants.

layers.name: Test Infrastructure
layers.description: Test fixtures, fuzzing targets, and event data used to verify format parsers and rendering correctness.

layers.name: Documentation
layers.description: User manual, plugin developer guide, and project documentation in markdown and mdBook format.

layers.name: Scripts and Spikes
layers.description: Build scripts, development tooling, CI helper scripts, and experimental GUI/audio spikes.

layers.name: Configuration
layers.description: Cargo manifests, plugin manifests, Debian packaging config, and other project configuration files.

layers.name: CI/CD Pipelines
layers.description: GitHub Actions workflows for CI, builds, releases, fuzzing, interop testing, and documentation deployment.

tour.title: Welcome to OxiGuitar
tour.description: Project overview: what OxiGuitar is, its workspace structure, and how the crates are organized. Start here to understand the big picture before diving into any specific crate.

tour.title: Core Data Model
tour.description: The music data types that everything else builds on: bars, notes, tracks, scores, durations, ratios, and the wire format. This is the foundation of the entire application.

tour.title: Playback Engine
tour.description: How OxiGuitar plays back music: the scheduling engine, event processing, timing, and plugin source abstraction. This is where the data model becomes audible sound.

tour.title: File Format Plugins
tour.description: How OxiGuitar reads and writes Guitar Pro files (GP3-8, GPX) and other formats through its plugin architecture. The formats crate handles binary parsing, XML parsing, format detection, and round-trip fidelity.

tour.title: The Editor
tour.description: How OxiGuitar edits music: entry, bars, caret, effects, harmony, selection, transpose, and history. The edit crate provides the operations that transform the data model.

tour.title: Display & Layout Engine
tour.description: How OxiGuitar renders music: engraving, layout planning, system and page layout, hit detection, and visual rendering. This is where the data model becomes visual notation.

tour.title: Desktop Application
tour.description: The main GUI application: window shell, document management, canvas rendering, track panel, player controls, plugin tabs, and Slint UI. This is where everything comes together.

tour.title: Plugin System
tour.description: OxiGuitar's extensibility: the plugin API (ABI, manifests, score/tab/score2 interfaces), the plugin runtime (loading, glue, audio), and the test plugin infrastructure. Every file format, audio output, and tool is a plugin.

tour.title: Testing & Quality Assurance
tour.description: How OxiGuitar ensures correctness: corpus-based tests, round-trip tests, interop tests with alphaTab and MuseScore, fuzzing targets, golden file tests, and the extensive fixture collections.

tour.title: Build System & CI/CD
tour.description: How OxiGuitar is built and shipped: GitHub Actions workflows for CI, multi-platform builds, Debian packaging, releases, fuzzing, and documentation deployment.
